comparison.objective: Position floor monitors at microphone null angles—180 degrees for cardioid and 126 degrees for supercardioid; candidate removes tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Class-dependent angular placement of large objects versus small recessed-tool alignment, bimanual striking and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Each monitor reaches the prescribed microphone-relative angle; detailed tolerances are absent. Candidate requires four damage-free fractures and full containment.
comparison.reason: Angular scene arrangement does not test controlled impact fracture or retained-component integrity.
